boundary: Synthetic controller, filesystem and provider-adapter tests only. No real article, provider, deployment or production operation ran.

finalDelta.promotionBasis: The final delta only filters the owner-decision secret from worker child environments case-insensitively. The affected worker packet test and normal target/control controller were rerun at the final revision; the other probe implementations and their product dependencies are unchanged.

observations.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='tampered concrete activity output|three distinct unsuccessful finding repairs' tests/article-import-activity-recovery.test.ts
observations.establishes: A changed accepted output reopens its producing activity, and three distinct unsuccessful finding repairs require bound diagnosis before a fourth worker.
observations.limitations: This does not establish a successful editorial repair, an adequate content-depth control, or a finding-specific controller catch beyond finding 36.

observations.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='cleanup refuses redirected archive|cleanup refuses an existing archive leaf|restart will not unlink|restart refuses to restore' tests/article-import-cleanup-recovery.test.ts
observations.establishes: Synthetic cleanup and restart refuse redirected archive, failure-receipt and work paths without mutating unrelated storage.
observations.limitations: No real article state or user file was deleted, restored or moved.

observations.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='release journal redacts raw provider|indeterminate deployment lookup|release command runner preserves|local adapter binds provider identity|local adapter rejects disagreement|local adapter fails closed|local adapter reports authentication' tests/article-import-release.test.ts
observations.establishes: Synthetic provider reads bind project, alias and served commit identity; indeterminate lookup stays held; shell metacharacters remain literal; retained diagnostics omit raw credentials and provider errors.
observations.limitations: Provider responses are synthetic. No deployment, alias change, rollback or production verification ran.

observations.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='target-bound current rendering tracks global build inputs' tests/article-rendering-inputs.test.ts
observations.establishes: Current target-bound rendering evidence includes global build inputs while ignoring an unrelated article file.
observations.limitations: This is input-custody evidence, not a fresh browser rendering or visual-quality judgment.

observations.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='activity workers receive one current activity' tests/article-worker-runner.test.ts
observations.establishes: The synthetic worker packet exposes one current activity and only accepted current-stage handoffs.
observations.limitations: This does not establish worker judgment quality, independent-review effectiveness or owner adjudication.
